push.body:
PhogsToffees, you posted a 7.6 against kromium. Keep doing the simple things this well.

THE GOOD
+ 3 shots at kromium's goal. You kept knocking on that door like a Girl Scout with a quota.
+ 4 key passes (up from your usual 2). You're the reason the forwards have something to celebrate.
+ You and BellyTb1 were finishing each other's sentences out there.

+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. You can build a whole match on that.

Remember, PhogsToffees: The best time to plant a tree was yesterday. The second best is next match.

Patience with yourself, please. - Coach Lasso

+ 7 tackles attempted (up from your usual 3). Hustle like that doesn't show up in highlights, but it shows up in results.

- Pair up with buddskees on finishing: square it when the keeper commits.
- This result ended our promotion push in Division 3. We win together and we wear this together.

This week's homework: Show them down the line, toward the touchline and away from goal, then strike.

tuxedo_slide, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Your feet are only as fast as your eyes. Look first.

Next match, we go again. - Coach Lasso
